reason: AI runtime needs one lifecycle mount without creating a second Control Plane.
contract: Inject one killable non-critical managed port
require typed start, stop, probe, bounded resources and AI-off semantics.
tests: Prove start/stop/probe failure paths
boot/recovery/shutdown with AI directory, service and provider absent.
expectedBehavior: Core startup, operation, recovery and shutdown remain unchanged when AI is absent or unavailable

reason: AI reads and proposals need authenticated Product-plane ingress without a second API authority.
contract: Add bounded AI-Ops read, chat and proposal request/response schemas behind existing operator middleware.
tests: Run authenticated/unauthenticated route tests
reject malformed, oversized and mutation-bearing read/chat payloads.
expectedBehavior: read/chat routes cannot mutate canonical state.

reason: Durable AI records must use the sole canonical persistence owner.
contract: Add Ledger migrations/adapters for cases, transitions, inbox, outbox, DLQ, attempts, effects, usage, approvals, evidence hashes and retention pointers.
tests: Prove backup, restore, restart, replay, compare-and-set conflict and corrupt-record failure behavior.
expectedBehavior: no second store or file journal.

reason: Human and worker principals require distinct default-deny scopes.
contract: Bind separately authenticated human owner and isolated worker principals to explicit role, tool and provider scopes using non-secret references.
tests: Prove deny-by-default, role separation, revocation and credential-non-exposure with hostile cross-identity attempts.
expectedBehavior: No subscription credential reaches application, browser, model, repository or worker context
no inherited identity or fallback authority.

reason: Lane-local work cannot edit shared scripts, dependencies or lockfiles.
contract: Apply only dependency/script deltas named by sealed accepted lane receipts.
tests: Run lockfile integrity, offline network-free tests, license/security and dependency-necessity checks.
expectedBehavior: lanes remain buildable without hidden network/provider calls.

reason: Isolated worker/sentinel deployment and AI-off gates belong to the release owner.
contract: Add owner-approved isolated service, worker and sentinel templates plus canary, rollback and AI-off fault gates.
tests: Validate templates with fake credentials/endpoints
prove canary, rollback, revocation and independent readback.
expectedBehavior: later deployment requires fresh owner approval and leaves core deterministic when AI is off.

reason: Deterministic campaigns exist only as pure vocabulary and cannot silently become an executor.
contract: Ratify a typed action-request contract, registered runbooks, durable checkpoint and existing-effect-owner bindings
tests: Prove lease, fence, idempotency, precondition, postcondition, quiet period, checkpoint/restart and forbidden-action failure cases.
expectedBehavior: effects run only through existing owners

reason: AI queue, drop, lag, provider, case and resource facts need canonical health projection.
contract: Register bounded observations without a second telemetry or health authority.
tests: Inject missing, stale, future, dropped, saturated and provider-outage evidence
run core non-degradation soak.
expectedBehavior: core service remains within signed overhead budgets.

reason: Provider access, if ever approved, needs explicit allowlisting and non-secret injection.
contract: Admit only owner-approved endpoints through a credential-injection proxy with endpoint, method, schema, role, budget and retention bounds.
tests: Keep unit tests network-free
hostile DNS/redirect/method/schema tests
prove exchange hosts and private exchange calls remain denied.

reason: Evaluator vocabulary exists but no independently deployed sentinel owner is configured.
contract: Bind an external read-only sentinel in a separate failure domain with no trading or patch authority.
tests: Prove independent liveness/readback, stale/missing delivery, main-app outage and sentinel-outage fault cases.
expectedBehavior: it cannot execute, trade, patch or mint product readiness.

targetSeam: Production owner MISSING; S6 append/retention receipt contracts; canonical Ledger insertion seam
reason: AI provenance requires independently administered append-only/WORM delivery distinct from sentinel execution.
contract: Ratify audit retention, delivery, readback, chain/hash and restoration contract through the canonical Ledger owner.
tests: Prove append chain, tamper detection, delivery loss, retention expiry, restore and independent readback.
expectedBehavior: Audit loss is visible within the signed interval
no worker can rewrite/delete evidence or administer its own audit sink.

reason: Mounted AI components need canonical inventory and supervisor truth.
contract: Insert only ratified AI identities, availability, blockers and component posture into Product runtime projections.
tests: Prove absent, starting, healthy, degraded, unavailable and killed states plus exact blocker propagation.
expectedBehavior: AI absence cannot degrade or falsify core readiness.

targetSeam: Production owner/path MISSING; Product command preview/result types are evidence only, not a generic ApprovalRequest/ApprovalReceipt owner
reason: Elevated AI proposals require separately authenticated human approval that no AI/service can satisfy.
contract: Ratify typed approval request/receipt binding artifact, parameters, expiry, principal, reauthentication and execution readback.
tests: Prove expiry, replay, parameter substitution, AI-as-approver, inherited-chat and credential/role-confusion failures.
expectedBehavior: Only the authenticated human owner approves
release service executes only exact approved artifact.

reason: Provider and worker configuration must be explicit, revocable and separate from secrets.
tests: Prove default NOT_CONFIGURED, invalid config rejection, redaction, save/load round-trip, deconfiguration and no-secret scans.
expectedBehavior: missing config remains honest and core deterministic.

reason: Accepted lane gates need one canonical root acceptance mount.
contract: Register sealed lane tests and AI-off/fault gates only after acceptance.
tests: Run focused lane suites, network-free root suite, complete acceptance, hostile false-green and exact exit-code checks.
expectedBehavior: accepted counts and commands are recorded in canonical state/receipt.
